description_expanded: The Pelagic Blue - Beachfront Vacation Home on 30A with Large Private Pool & Direct Beach Access Favorite Features: - Beachfront Porch - Private Pool - In-Home Elevator - Private Beach Access - Complimentary Beach Chairs (In-Season) - 4 Included Bikes More About The Pelagic Blue: The Pelagic Blue is an extraordinary beachfront home located right on County Highway 30A! It is one of the largest homes, at 5,800 square feet, on the west end of 30A. No other 30A property offers you this much space or the same panoramic gulf views! The private pool deck adds extra entertainment space with an in-ground pool, a built-in grill, and a pergola. The Pelagic Blue offers seven spacious bedrooms and seven and a half bathrooms accommodating 18 guests. The beach-front location, directly on the Gulf of Mexico is central to the experience you’ll have at The Pelagic Blue. A back patio and pool, along with a private boardwalk down to the beach make it easy to enjoy the Gulf. To top it off, guests will be entitled to the 100 feet of private beach! Three stories of balcony space also provide great vantage points for observing the beautiful Gulf views. The home is also right across the street from Stinky’s Fish Camp – one of the best restaurants on 30A. Like all Five Star Properties’ rentals, The Pelagic Blue is professionally decorated and furnished with high-end furniture. The three-story home has three living areas (one on each floor) with soaring 18-foot ceilings.  Huge LCD flat screen TVs are placed in the living area and every bedroom. On the third floor, there is a wet bar ideal for prepping drinks and appetizers. On the second floor, double lanai doors allow open-air views of the Gulf and the pool. The structure makes it appear as if the waves are breaking right under you, making this a one-of-a-kind vacation home. High quality and fresh linens and towels are provided at every guest's stay, along with luxury bath soaps. Imagine a hotel experience in the comfort of a home. Five Star exclusively offers the most luxurious homes on 30A without exception. You can book The Pelagic Blue – the largest vacation rental on west 30A – today. Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower & Soaking Tub. Deck Access & Gulf View. Bedroom 2: Twin over Twin Bunk & Twin over Twin over Twin Bunk. SECOND FLOOR Bedroom 3: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower & Soaking Tub. Shared Balcony & Gulf View. Bedroom 4: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. THIRD FLOOR Bedroom 5: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower & Soaking Tub.  Shared Balcony & Gulf View. Bedroom 6: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 7: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower & Soaking Tub.  Shared Balcony & Gulf View.
